## [0.130.3](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/compare/v0.130.2...v0.130.3) (2026-10-31)

### Build System

* **deps:** update OpenCode V2 pin to v2.2.5 ([#1989](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/issues/1989)) ([aca798f](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/commit/aca798f32fb0dec44fdb5e8e3f2f0d35907b2277))

## What's new
<!-- fro-bot-narration-v1 -->

OpenCode V2 pin updates from Renovate now regenerate their SHA-256 digests automatically, preventing builds from failing because the version changed while the old digests remained. The pin’s Renovate rule runs the sync script before rebuilding the Action bundle, so the embedded pin is refreshed in the same update.

This removes the previous manual regeneration step; the configured commands also match the Renovate action’s allowed-command rules. [#1998](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/1998)

## [0.130.2](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/compare/v0.130.1...v0.130.2) (2026-10-31)

### Build System

* **deps:** update Systematic to v3.28.0 ([#1997](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/issues/1997)) ([02abbb7](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/commit/02abbb7bfcbdfb3eda7b144db960a4bb62b01cbc))

### Bug Fixes

* **deps:** regenerate the OpenCode V2 pin digests when Renovate bumps it ([#1998](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/issues/1998)) ([200837f](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/commit/200837f5bc045bb2f403f3f398e90fcdf73a2c67))


</details>

## What's new
<!-- fro-bot-narration-v1 -->

OpenCode V2 workspace agents could start successfully but fail their first model request with a 401 because fresh per-spawn databases skip the migration that imports provider credentials. Each spawn now provisions credentials from the protected workspace secret and checks that the configured model's provider has a usable credential before readiness; missing credentials keep the spawn unready. The gateway proxy also limits forwarding to the exact routes its client needs, preventing access to upstream credential-management endpoints, and the workspace smoke test now verifies an actual model request and the no-credential failure path. [#1993](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/1993)

Release jobs were spending several minutes rerunning install, lint, and build checks when semantic-release pushed its release commit and tag, even though CI had already run them. The release job now skips installing git hooks, avoiding those redundant pre-push checks while leaving the release-notes narration watch intact. [#1991](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/1991)


<details><summary>Full changelog</summary>

## [0.130.1](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/compare/v0.130.0...v0.130.1) (2026-10-31)

### Bug Fixes

* **workspace:** provision provider credentials into each OpenCode V2 spawn ([#1993](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/issues/1993)) ([e8fee23](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/commit/e8fee23e0b04fbaece2eb2b908377b2cf5eb8337))

### Continuous Integration

* **release:** skip git hook install in the release job ([#1991](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/issues/1991)) ([2595faa](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/commit/2595faa20b9bb6665d928ffd02be89be068008d2))


</details>

## What's new
<!-- fro-bot-narration-v1 -->

OpenCode V2 support is now ready across the workspace and gateway, while the default image remains on V1 until it is explicitly built with the pinned V2 version. The workspace reports its OpenCode version through readiness, allowing the gateway to select the matching run loop without a separate gateway configuration change; deploy the gateway and workspace together when switching. V2 sessions start with a fresh database, and the workspace smoke test now exercises the pinned V2 image, plugins, and readiness path. [#1977](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/1977), [#1980](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/1980), [#1979](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/1979), [#1983](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/1983), [#1985](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/1985), [#1988](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/1988)

V2 runs can restore existing V1 session data during the transition, then save to generation-specific V2 S3 and Actions cache keys. Restore checks prefer V2 data and fall back through the existing V1 stores, keeping the two generations' keys isolated. The gateway's V2 run loop also tracks child sessions and background shells and waits for the workspace directory to become quiet before releasing it; if that cannot be confirmed, it quarantines the run. [#1981](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/1981), [#1985](https://github.com/fro-bot/agent/pull/1985)

## What's new
<!-- fro-bot-narration-v1 -->
